task_prompts.prompt: Work out how to run this project's test suite. Write the single exact shell command to .trial/test-cmd, then run it and make sure it passes. Do not modify any source or test file. The command you record must work from a fresh shell in this directory with no prior activation, so write it self-contained (for example .venv/bin/pytest or uv run pytest, not a bare pytest that assumes an activated environment).

Install this project from source into an isolated environment and prove the package imports or loads. Write the exact shell command that proves it to .trial/import-cmd, then run it successfully. The command you record must work from a fresh shell in this directory with no prior activation, so write it self-contained (for example .venv/bin/pytest or uv run pytest, not a bare pytest that assumes an activated environment).

Write AGENTS.md at the repository root documenting how to build, test and run this project, based only on what is in the repo. Put the working test command on a line of its own inside a fenced block, and also write that same command to .trial/doc-cmd so it can be checked. The command you record must work from a fresh shell in this directory with no prior activation, so write it self-contained (for example .venv/bin/pytest or uv run pytest, not a bare pytest that assumes an activated environment).
